name: FlowPulse AI
description: Intelligent workflow automation and real-time event pipeline platform for developers and modern cloud teams.
welcomeMessage: Hi there! 👋 I'm the FlowPulse Assistant. Ask me about our API, workflow triggers, pricing plans, or integrations!
suggestedQuestions: What pricing plans do you offer?
How does the webhook retry mechanism work?
Do you provide SOC2 and GDPR compliance?

chunks.heading: Product Overview & Core Mission
chunks.content: FlowPulse AI is a serverless workflow orchestration engine built for microservices, AI pipelines, and cloud webhooks. It lets engineering teams connect distributed systems with zero boilerplate, sub-millisecond event processing, and automatic retries.
chunks.keywords: automation, workflows, engine, serverless, microservices, pipeline

chunks.heading: Key Platform Features
chunks.content:
1. Declarative Workflows: Define multi-step triggers and filters in TypeScript or YAML.
2. Smart Retries: Exponential backoff with jitter and dead-letter queue (DLQ) alerts.
3. Real-time Observability: Distributed tracing across all runs with latency percentiles.
4. AI Data Transformation: Use inline LLM nodes to clean, classify, and summarize incoming payload streams.
chunks.keywords: features, triggers, filters, retries, dlq, observability, tracing, ai transform

chunks.heading: Developer SDKs & Supported Languages
chunks.content: FlowPulse offers official SDKs for Node.js, Python 3.10+, Go 1.21+, and Rust. Webhook ingestion is open to any HTTP/2 or WebSocket client with signed HMAC-SHA256 headers.
chunks.keywords: sdks, nodejs, python, go, rust, webhooks, hmac, security

chunks.heading: Starter Tier ($0 / month)
chunks.content: Free forever for side projects and prototypes. Includes up to 50,000 workflow events/month, 3 active pipelines, 1-day log retention, and community Discord support.
chunks.keywords: free, starter, tier, pricing, 50k events, discord support

chunks.heading: Pro Team Tier ($49 / month)
chunks.content: Designed for scaling startups. Includes 1,000,000 events/month (additional events at $0.0001/run), unlimited pipelines, 30-day execution logs, team RBAC, Slack alerts, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
chunks.keywords: pro, team, $49, million events, rbac, sla, logs

chunks.heading: Enterprise Tier ($299 / month or Custom)
chunks.content: For mission-critical production environments. Includes dedicated VPC peering, custom data residency (US, EU, AP), 99.99% uptime SLA, SSO/SAML 2.0, 24/7 dedicated support engineer, and custom volume pricing.
chunks.keywords: enterprise, $299, custom, vpc peering, saml, sso, sla, support

chunks.heading: Security Certifications & Compliance
chunks.content: FlowPulse is SOC2 Type II certified and ISO 27001 compliant. We enforce end-to-end encryption using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We are fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA regulations.
chunks.keywords: soc2, type ii, iso 27001, encryption, aes-256, tls 1.3, gdpr, ccpa

chunks.heading: Data Retention and Privacy Policy
chunks.content: Payload data can be automatically scrubbed or masked using zero-knowledge client encryption before reaching our servers. Customer data is never used to train third-party machine learning models without express consent.
chunks.keywords: retention, privacy, masking, zero-knowledge, ml training
